node_01_bg: Background: The outskirts of the city, a rainy night, an old broadcasting station building. A sign streaked with rainwater, a flickering neon sign reading "Starlight Broadcasting."
node_03_pl: "I came here drawn by a job posting I happened to see, but it’s obviously on the verge of going under..."
node_05_bg: Inside the building: a dust-covered reception desk, a dark hallway.
node_08_bg: Inside the office, piles of documents cover the desk, and a woman in her fifties seated in a chair smiles.
node_09_ld: "I’m the former owner of this broadcasting station."
node_10_ld: "From now on, this station is yours."
node_11_pl: "Wait a moment... I just came here to apply for a job."
node_12_ld: "Is that so? But I’ve taken a shine to you."
node_13_ld: "Instead of a salary... I’ll give you the station."
node_15_bg: Old broadcasting equipment, cameras, lights, and posters on the wall... women in sexy concepts.
node_17_ld: "It’s an adult broadcasting station. That’s why all the staff ran away."
node_18_ld: "But... this is an era where it makes money. You know that too, don’t you?"
node_20_bg: On the computer screen, thumbnails of provocative videos from past broadcasts are displayed.
node_21_ld: "Don’t worry. Right now there’s no one, but..."
node_22_ld: "You just have to go find creators yourself. Scouting—you know what that is?"
node_23_ld: "You just... need to create an environment where they can broadcast comfortably."
node_26_bg: As soon as I sign, she presses a heavy crimson seal onto the contract.
node_28_ld: "Now that you’ve taken over the station... there’s only one thing left to do."
node_30_bg: After Madam leaves, dawn light seeps faintly through the window of the office where I’m left alone.
node_33_pl: "All right. Let’s start by finding creators."
